CustomField.description: What a tool of this type can change, which decides how Core recovers a failed or lost call. Stays in This Org: Core runs each call inside a savepoint, so a failed or lost call leaves nothing behind and may repeat. Reads Outside Systems: the tool calls outside systems but never changes anything there, so Core repeats a failed or lost call. Changes Outside Systems: Core never repeats a call whose outcome is unconfirmed unless the tool itself asks for a retry, and an operator reconciles it instead. Core treats an unknown value as Changes Outside Systems.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Stays in This Org: reads or changes this org's records only. Reads Outside Systems: only looks things up elsewhere, such as a GET request. Changes Outside Systems: may send, create, change, or delete anything outside, including email. When unsure, choose Changes Outside Systems.
CustomField.label: Effects
